note: The armor passives (HD2Runtime research player-attributes-F5FEE03DCFDB.json, sdk/ArmorPassiveCatalog.json): the id the game's applied customization record holds (+0x3C armor, +0x38 second), the game's name, the description with its values, the effect package a passive needs resident (HellForge does not load those yet: such a passive is refused unless it is the armor's own), whether only the armor slot works, and how much of it follows a swap (partial: some stats apply only at spawn).

passives.name: STANDARD ISSUE
passives.title: Standard Issue
passives.description: No additional bonuses.

passives.name: EXTRA PADDING
passives.title: Extra Padding
passives.description: Provides a higher armor rating.

passives.name: SCOUT
passives.title: Scout
passives.description: Markers placed on the map will generate radar scans every 2s. Reduces range at which enemies can detect the wearer by 30%.

passives.name: FORTIFIED
passives.title: Fortified
passives.description: Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by 30%. Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage.

passives.name: ELECTRICAL CONDUIT
passives.title: Electrical Conduit
passives.description: Provides 95% resistance to arc damage.

passives.name: ENGINEERING KIT
passives.title: Engineering Kit
passives.description: Further reduces recoil when crouching or prone by 30%. Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by 2.

passives.name: MED-KIT
passives.title: Med-Kit
passives.description: Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of stims by +2. Increases stim effect duration by 2s.

passives.name: SERVO-ASSISTED
passives.title: Servo-Assisted
passives.description: Increases throwing range by 30%. Provides +50% limb health.

passives.name: DEMOCRACY PROTECTS
passives.title: Democracy Protects
passives.description: 50% chance to not die when taking lethal damage. Prevents all damage from bleeding if chest hemorrhages.

passives.name: REINFORCED EPAULETTES
passives.title: Reinforced Epaulettes
passives.description: Increases reload speed of primary weapons by 30%. Gives wearer a 50% chance to avoid grievous limb injury. Increases melee damage by 20%.

passives.name: INFLAMMABLE
passives.title: Inflammable
passives.description: Provides 75% damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability.

passives.name: PEAK PHYSIQUE
passives.title: Peak Physique
passives.description: Increases melee damage by 40%. Increases weapon ergonomics to reduce drag on weapon movement.

passives.name: ADVANCED FILTRATION
passives.title: Advanced Filtration
passives.description: Provides 80% resistance to gas damage and effects.

passives.name: UNFLINCHING
passives.title: Unflinching
passives.description: Helps prevent Helldivers from flinching when hit. Provides a higher armor rating. Markers placed on the map will generate radar scans every 2s.

passives.name: ACCLIMATED
passives.title: Acclimated
passives.description: Provides 50% resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage.

passives.name: SIEGE-READY
passives.title: Siege-Ready
passives.description: Increases reload speed of primary weapons by 30%. Increases ammo capacity of all weapons by 20%. Does not affect weapon backpacks.

passives.name: INTEGRATED EXPLOSIVES
passives.title: Integrated Explosives
passives.description: Armor explodes 1.5s after the wearer dies. Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by 2.

passives.name: GUNSLINGER
passives.title: Gunslinger
passives.description: Increases sidearms reload speed by 40%. Sidearm draw/holster speed increased by 50%. Sidearm recoil reduced by 70%.

passives.name: ADRENO-DEFIBRILLATOR
passives.title: Adreno-Defibrillator
passives.description: Provides one-time, short-lived resuscitation upon death, given that the Helldiver's body is still intact. Increases stim effect duration by 2s. Provides 50% resistance to arc damage.

passives.name: BALLISTIC PADDING
passives.title: Ballistic Padding
passives.description: Provides 25% resistance to chest damage. Provides 25% resistance to explosive damage. Prevents all damage from bleeding if chest hemorrhages.

passives.name: DESERT STORMER
passives.title: Desert Stormer
passives.description: Provides 40% resistance to fire, gas, acid, and electrical damage. Increases throwing range by 20%.

passives.name: FEET FIRST
passives.title: Feet First
passives.description: Wearer makes 50% less noise when moving. Increases point-of-interest identification range by 30%. Provides immunity to leg injuries.

passives.name: REDUCED SIGNATURE
passives.title: Reduced Signature
passives.description: Wearer makes 50% less noise when moving. Reduces range at which enemies can detect the wearer by 40%.

passives.name: ROCK-SOLID
passives.title: Rock-Solid
passives.description: Increases melee damage by 40%. Bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone.

passives.name: SUPPLEMENTAL ADRENALINE
passives.title: Supplemental Adrenaline
passives.description: When the wearer takes damage, they regain some stamina. Provides a higher armor rating.

passives.name: CONCUSSIVE PADDING, REINFORCED
passives.title: Concussive Padding, Reinforced
passives.description: Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage. Provides a higher armor rating.

passives.name: CONCUSSIVE PADDING, GRENADIER
passives.title: Concussive Padding, Grenadier
passives.description: Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage. Increases initial inventory and holding capacity of throwables by 2.

passives.name: CONCUSSIVE PADDING, HAZMAT
passives.title: Concussive Padding, Hazmat
passives.description: Provides 50% resistance to explosive damage. Provides 25% resistance to gas damage and effects. Sidearm recoil reduced by 30%.

passives.name: OXYGENATOR
passives.title: Oxygenator
passives.description: Increases the wearer's walking and running speed. Increases the speed and duration of slides.

passives.name: KINETIC DISPLACEMENT MITIGATION
passives.title: Kinetic Displacement Mitigation
passives.description: Provides 50% damage resistance to fire, allowing bearer to rest assured in their inflammability. Gives wearer a 50% chance to avoid grievous limb injury. Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by 30%.

passives.name: BLUNT-FORCE MITIGATION
passives.title: Blunt-Force Mitigation
passives.description: Bearer is more resistant to being knocked prone. Reduces damage taken from impact and collisions by 30%. Provides a higher armor rating.

passives.name: TRUE GRIT
passives.title: True Grit
passives.description: Increases reload speed of support weapons by 30%. Slightly increases weapon ergonomics to reduce drag on weapon movement.
